[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
William Glasgow is named as the father of Martha Glasgow, baptised on 6 August 1809 at Lloyd Street Presbyterian Chapel, Manchester. The mother is named Ann; her maiden surname is not given.
<ref name="william1809-0">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9841/records/86820999 Ancestry, England, Select Births and Christenings, 1538-1975: William Glasgow, 6 Aug 1809]. Provider index entry; original register uninspected.</ref>
<ref name="william1809-1">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9841/records/86820998 Ancestry, England, Select Births and Christenings, 1538-1975: William Glasgow, 6 Aug 1809]. Provider index entry; original register uninspected.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
This is a record-defined account, not an independently established second man. Its preferred probable identification is [[Glasgow-3545|William Glasgow]], husband of Ann Denham, assessed at 84% subjective confidence. The 1805 Manchester marriage and the same William-and-Ann names at Lloyd Street for Robert in 1806, Martha in 1809, Agnus in 1812 and William in 1816 support one household. Another couple or transcription error remains possible. Do not create a separate WikiTree father while this identity question is open. Other tentative children assigned to this documentary account require their own review and have not been transferred. Ann Denham’s identity as Martha’s mother has not been established.
